# Import checklist

**1 folders · 28 markups · 1 imports**

Before you start:
- onX **Premium or Elite** is required to import.
- Use the **Web Map** at webmap.onxmaps.com on a computer.
- Each numbered step is ONE import. Drag in **all** the files for that step together.

### 1. Edge Cases  (28 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **Edge_Cases_Waypoints.gpx, Edge_Cases_Tracks.gpx, Edge_Cases_Areas.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `Edge Cases`

### Notes longer than onX keeps on import (512 bytes)

onX keeps the first 512 bytes of an imported note -- about 512 characters of plain English; accented letters, dashes and emoji take 2-4 bytes each. Shorten these, or paste the rest into onX after import. (One earlier 3,000+ character note from an onX export was dropped outright, for a reason we have not found.)

- `[r2i1] ZZTEST note 513`: 513 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST note 600`: 600 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST note 1000`: 1000 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST note 3000`: 3000 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST utf8 note 513B`: 513 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST utf8 note mid-char`: 514 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST line note 513`: 513 bytes  (Edge Cases)
- `[r2i1] ZZTEST line note 3000`: 3000 bytes  (Edge Cases)

---

When finished, My Content should show **1 folders** and **28 markups**.

If a folder is missing items, delete that folder and redo just its step.
